rows.ARS:
Mauve or mauve blend Floribunda.
Exhibition name: Minerva ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Martin Vissers (Belgium, 2004).
Introduced in Belgium by Viva International BVBA in 2010 as 'Minerva'.
rows.Bloom: Purple, golden-yellow stamens, ages to light blue . Strong, sweet fragrance. Average diameter 3.25". Medium to large, full (26-40 petals), cluster-flowered, cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b and warmer. Can be used for beds and borders, container rose or cut flower. Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant, very blackspot resistant., very mildew resistant. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) . Can be grown in the ground or in a container (container requires winter protection).
rows.Notes: Dedicated to Belgium's old glory and premier automotive marque. Minerva built cars from 1899 to 1939 in Antwerp, and introduced the now standard four-wheel braking system in 1926. Rose Minerva® is sold in cooperation with Minerva Lions group in Antwerp for charity.

colour: Purple, golden-yellow stamens, ages to light blue .
